title: 第16章 腕间星空，属于上位者的顶级气场！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    第二天早上。

    香格里拉大酒店门前。

    初秋的阳光打在酒店巨大的玻璃旋转门上，折射出刺眼的光晕。

    叶知秋站在台阶上，穿了一身剪裁极好的浅灰色职业套装，

    裙摆停在膝盖上方三公分的位置，干练又不失风情。手里拿着两个崭新的文件袋。

    她在等林川。

    一阵低沉而狂野的发动机嘶吼声从停车区出口处撕裂了早高峰的嘈杂。

    一辆银白色的法拉利360 MOdena贴着地面掠过车流，精准地滑入酒店门前的VIP落客区。

    周围等车的客人和门童全都看过来了。

    车窗缓缓降下。

    林川单手扶着方向盘，鼻梁上架着一副墨镜，穿着件没有任何lOgO的黑色休闲衬衫，领口随意地敞开两颗扣子。

    “上车。”

    叶知秋的视线在那辆车身上停了两秒。

    法拉利。

    “发什么愣？”林川摘下墨镜看着她。

    叶知秋没再多说，踩着高跟鞋走下台阶，拉开副驾驶的车门坐了进去。

    车厢里冷气开得很足，包裹性极强的真皮座椅散发着皮革特有的冷香。

    叶知秋系好安全带，打开手里的文件袋。

    “林先生，汇报一下账户情况。”她的声音恢复了职业状态，

    “亿安科技这几天走势非常恐怖，目前我们账户的浮盈已经超过了百分之八十。”

    她停顿了一下，转头看向林川。

    “整个营业部的大户室都在盯着这只票，甚至有人在打听我们账户的底细。您看……要不要先抛一部分，落袋为安？”

    百分之八十。

    三千万的本金，意味着账户里凭空多出了两千四百多万的利润。

    换成任何一个正常人，面对这种级别的暴利，早就吓得夜不能寐了。

    林川双手搭在方向盘上，目光看着前方的路况。

    “抛什么？”

    语气轻得像在说一件无关紧要的事。

    “这票的庄家胃口大得很，现在连开胃菜都算不上。

    ”他手指在方向盘上轻轻敲着节奏，“不急，让子弹再飞一会儿。没有我的指令，一股都不许动。”

    两千多万的利润，在他嘴里连开胃菜都不算。

    叶知秋看着他平静的侧脸，脑子里飞速转着：如果这还不是顶点，这只股票到底要涨到什么地步？

    “明白了。”她合上文件袋，没再多问。

    上午，华侨城，波托菲诺纯水岸。

    林川看了顶层的复式楼王，装修地段采光都合他心意，当场签了合同。

    三百二十万，全款。

    售楼部经理全程双手都在抖。

    从售楼部出来，叶知秋坐进副驾驶时，忍不住多看了林川一眼。三千万砸进股市，两三百万的法拉利，现在又是三百二十万的楼王。这个人手里的现金，到底有多少？

    她不敢问。

    中午。

    中信城市广场。

    晚上要赴顾城的局，那个圈子里的人眼睛比谁都毒——你开什么车，戴什么表，穿什么衣服，就是你的无形名片。

    要入局，先得有入局的样子。

    一家意大利顶级手工定制西装店。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The next morning.

In front of Shangri-La Hotel.

The early autumn sunshine hits the huge glass revolving door of the hotel, reflecting a dazzling halo.

Ye Zhiqiu stood on the steps, wearing a well-tailored light gray professional suit.

The hem of the skirt stops three centimeters above the knee, making it smart yet elegant.He held two brand new document bags in his hands.

She is waiting for Lin Chuan.

A deep and wild engine roar tore through the noise of the morning rush hour from the exit of the parking area.

A silver-white Ferrari 360 MODena skimmed the traffic flow and slid accurately into the VIP drop-off area in front of the hotel.

The guests and doormen waiting for the bus all looked over.

The car window slowly lowered.

Lin Chuan was holding the steering wheel with one hand, wearing a pair of sunglasses on the bridge of his nose, and wearing a black casual shirt without any logo, with two buttons open at the collar casually.

"Get in the car."

Ye Zhiqiu’s eyes stopped on that car for two seconds.

Ferrari.

"What are you stunned for?" Lin Chuan took off his sunglasses and looked at her.

Ye Zhiqiu didn't say anything more, walked down the steps on high heels, opened the passenger door and got in.

The air-conditioning in the cabin is fully turned on, and the highly wrapped leather seats exude the unique cold fragrance of leather.

Ye Zhiqiu fastened his seat belt and opened the document bag in his hand.

"Mr. Lin, please report the account status." Her voice returned to a professional tone,

"The trend of Yi'an Technology in the past few days has been very scary. The current floating profit of our account has exceeded 80%."

She paused for a moment and turned to look at Lin Chuan.

"The entire sales department is staring at this ticket, and some people are even inquiring about the details of our account. Do you think... should you throw away part of it first and be safe?"

Eighty percent.

The principal of 30 million yuan means that there is more than 24 million yuan in profit out of thin air in the account.

“Any normal person would have been so scared that he could not sleep at night when faced with this level of huge profits.

Lin Chuan put his hands on the steering wheel and looked at the road ahead.

"What to throw?"

The tone was as light as if he was talking about something insignificant.

“The banker of this ticket has a huge appetite, and now it’s not even an appetizer.

"" His fingers tapped the rhythm on the steering wheel, "Don't worry, let the bullets fly for a while."No one is allowed to move without my order."

The profit of more than 20 million yuan is not even an appetizer in his mouth.

Ye Zhiqiu looked at his calm profile, his mind racing: If this is not the peak, how high will this stock rise?

"I understand." She closed the document bag and didn't ask any more questions.

In the morning, OCT, Portofino Pure Waterfront.

Lin Chuan saw the duplex on the top floor and found that the decoration and lighting were to his liking, so he signed the contract on the spot.

Three million two hundred thousand, full payment.

The sales manager’s hands were shaking the whole time.

After coming out of the sales department, when Ye Zhiqiu got into the passenger seat, he couldn't help but take another look at Lin Chuan.Thirty million dollars poured into the stock market, a Ferrari worth two to three million dollars, and now a property owner worth three million and two million dollars.How much cash does this person have?

She didn’t dare to ask.

noon.

CITIC City Plaza.

We have to go to Gucheng’s office in the evening, and the people in that circle have more vicious eyes than anyone else - the car you drive, the watch you wear, and the clothes you wear are your invisible business cards.

To enter the game, you must first appear to be in the game.

​A top Italian handmade custom suit shop.
